Request path (solid)
1 Engineer opens the app · 2 Sign-in: Cognito hosted UI, authorization code + PKCE, authenticator-app MFA · 3 API calls with the Cognito ID token (CORS limited to the app origin) · 4 Web assets for the AWS-hosted UI · 5 CloudFront forwards /api/* over HTTP to an ALB that accepts only CloudFront origin addresses · 6 ALB to Fargate tasks · 7 API verifies the token signature with Cognito JWKS · 8 Sessions, assessments, conversation turns and embeddings, as a non-bypass role under row-level security · 9 Chat (Gemma 3 12B) and embeddings (Titan Text Embeddings V2), both on-demand in us-east-2 · 10 Database credentials · 11 Queue-triggered ingestion task · 12 promoted data access · 14 logs, metrics and alarms
Build and data preparation (dashed)
13 Image pull · 15 Container image build/push (workflow defined; demo images were pushed manually) · 16 Documentation publish · 17 Verified NASA archive preserved in S3 · 18 Static JSON export for the showcase · 19 Operator submits a versioned ingestion request
